title: biscutella ciliata var. columnae
intro: Biscutella ciliata var. columnae, commonly known as Alpine Pennycress, is a plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential to provide health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate conditions like arthritis and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Pennycress include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
